overall_critique: Exceptional post-production quality and sleek UI integration. The HUD system (cyber-tactical athletic motif with high-contrast amber/cyan accents) creates instant retention and clear pedagogical value. Rep counters, anatomical target tags, and RPE ratings deliver strong biomechanical credibility. Safe zone clearances, pacing structure, and typographic hierarchy are tuned perfectly for short-form algorithms.

safe_zone_audit.top_safe_zone: The global energy progress bar runs cleanly along the top border, while the 'HAMZAWY // 4K MASTER' and 'EXERCISE X / 8' badges sit comfortably within the 8%–12% vertical band, safely clearing native platform UI notches and status headers.
safe_zone_audit.right_action_zone: All exercise titles and info card boundaries terminate with ample negative space on the right, keeping them 15%–20% clear of TikTok's engagement stack (Like, Comment, Save, Share).
safe_zone_audit.bottom_caption_zone: The lower HUD card and rep progress bar are anchored between 70% and 80% screen height, staying cleanly above TikTok's native audio disc, user handle, and caption overlay area.

color_and_lighting_audit.skin_tone_naturalness: 9.4/10 - Skin tones are natural and authentic under ambient gym illumination, with no sickly oversaturation or clipping in highlights.
color_and_lighting_audit.color_balance: 9.5/10 - Excellent contrast ratio; dark slate HUD cards with vibrant amber/orange indicators cut through both light and dark gym machinery backgrounds.
color_and_lighting_audit.distraction_free: 9.2/10 - Clean stable composition throughout. Clip 6 exhibits a minor out-of-focus obstruction/finger blur in the bottom-left corner from the raw camera capture, but HUD placement completely masks potential visual disturbance.
